root_cause.text: The functions net_shaper_nl_get_doit() and net_shaper_nl_cap_get_doit() call nlmsg_free() after genlmsg_reply() fails, but genlmsg_reply() already consumes the reply skb via netlink_unicast() on all return paths, leading to a double-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that genlmsg_reply() hands the reply skb to netlink and netlink_unicast() consumes it; the patch removes the "goto free_msg" after genlmsg_reply() and instead returns its error directly, preventing the duplicate nlmsg_free() call.
